title: Alicia Keys Signs With CAA
summary: The singer was previously booked by WME.
contentText:
Alicia Keys has signed with Creative Artists Agency (CAA), the company announced on Monday (Aug. 3). Managed by Roc Nation, the singer was previously booked by William Morris Endeavor (WME).

Keys has had four No. 1 hits on the Billboard Hot 100 , including “Fallin” (2001), “My Boo” with Usher (2004), “No One” (2007) and “Empire State Of Mind” with Jay-Z (2009). She’s also had five albums hit No. 1 on the Billboard 200 , including her 2001 debut, Songs In A Minor , 2003’s The Diary Of Alicia Keys , 2005’s Unplugged , 2007’s As I Am and 2012’s Girl On Fire .

Keys’ last tour took place during the summer of 2023, with dates in arenas across North America, including Barclays Center and the Kia Forum.

The singer was a founding member of She Is The Music, a nonprofit that aims to help women working in music by providing opportunities including membership and songwriting sessions.

In an interview with The Times in April, Keys hinted that she’s working on new music. Her last album, Keys , arrived in 2021 and hit No. 41 on the Billboard 200.

Keys recently closed out the Knicks parade in New York City, where she performed “Empire State of Mind” for fans of the basketball team after it won its first championship title in 53 years.

In 2024, Broadway musical Hell’s Kitchen , inspired by Keys’ life and music, debuted. The musical went on to win two Tony Awards and the 2025 Grammy Award for best musical theater album. Dr. Dre honored her with the Global Impact Award at that year’s Grammy Awards.
